source: Figma MCP get_metadata; representative live browser reference inspection

rows.mapping: Reference chromatic scales intentionally map to Specimen semantic roles, not 20 decorative palettes. Obsidian/Paper/Mist neutral foundation, Amber-to-Iris hero and Iris interaction accent. Status-only functional tones remain named and do not become brand colors. Acid yellow is removed and guarded.
remainingGaps: Full combinatorial visual parity, manual assistive technology and physical device acceptance are not confirmed.

rows.mapping: Display, title, body, label, caption and mono roles map to the Specimen type scale with text-scaling support. Geist is the documented licensed fallback because Söhne font files were not supplied. Weight, size, tracking and line height are tokens.
remainingGaps: Full combinatorial visual parity, manual assistive technology and physical device acceptance are not confirmed.

rows.mapping: The owner's three-ribbon interlocking Specimen mark replaces Untitled and sample-company marks. The retained owner primary/app-icon crops define the canonical SVG trace; Flutter paths and platform artwork derive from that source. UiMark.appIcon preserves the separate Amber-tip treatment on Paper. Partner/company marks are host-supplied accessible widgets with neutral named fallbacks; this is a reusable logo-content slot, not copied third-party artwork.
remainingGaps: Full combinatorial visual parity, manual assistive technology and physical device acceptance are not confirmed.

rows.mapping: Phosphor regular and filled selected states replace the reference icon artwork by explicit user direction. Central registry and semantic keys prevent mixed icon families.
remainingGaps: Full combinatorial visual parity, manual assistive technology and physical device acceptance are not confirmed.

rows.mapping: Featured shapes/sizes, file formats, payment/provider identities, fractional rating and social authentication slots use approved colors and Phosphor. Trademark logos come from host assets or accessible name fallback. Emoji remains host text content and never status-only information.
remainingGaps: Full combinatorial visual parity, manual assistive technology and physical device acceptance are not confirmed.

rows.mapping: The three existing GlassLevel roles and UiGlassStyle expose shadow, sigma, fill, stroke and opaque-fallback slots. Specimen standard recipes deliberately use opaque neutral surfaces and boundaries; custom recipes retain shadow/blur capability and reduced/off quality controls. Catalog demonstrates the standard solid brand treatment, not a new decorative glass theme.
remainingGaps: Full combinatorial visual parity, manual assistive technology and physical device acceptance are not confirmed.

rows.mapping: Spacing/density tokens and responsive container/grid rules replace pixel-locked artboard grids. Children reflow at available width and large text; product density and responsive windows remain explicit.
remainingGaps: Full combinatorial visual parity, manual assistive technology and physical device acceptance are not confirmed.

rows.mapping: Responsive browser, phone and tablet frames accept actual product content. Browser title chrome and light/dark neutral surfaces replace reference portfolio screenshots. Native Safari chrome is represented by neutral product-preview chrome; no browser functionality is implied.

rows.mapping: Design review notes and keyboard combinations use UiNotice and UiKeyCap. UiDesignPointer provides Arrow, Drag and Hand as labelled Phosphor illustrations. UiMeasurement supplies solid dimension lines or hatched spacing bands with top, bottom, left or right labels; physical diagram placement remains fixed in RTL while labels use inherited text direction.
